summary: First-build full test of EFL REF Solar Intelligence Platform. Backend pytest suite (14 tests) all passing. Frontend flows all working end-to-end: home hero + demo metrics, calculator 6-step wizard with clean results (no NaN/Infinity), lead capture returning EFL-LEAD-* ref, financing EMI sliders updating, EPC register/submit/track, and all 11 secondary nav routes rendering.

minor.issue: Pydantic model requires contactPerson (no default). Spec says {companyName, mobile} should suffice; a minimal payload returns 422. Frontend supplies contactPerson so UI works, but the raw API contract is stricter than the spec. Consider making contactPerson Optional.

issues: Progression is correctly blocked when monthlyBill=0 on step 3, but no visible toast/validation message was detected in DOM after clicking Next. Users may not know why the wizard didn't advance. Suggest adding an inline error or persistent toast.

action_items: (Optional) Relax /api/epc/register: make contactPerson Optional to match spec of {companyName, mobile} minimal payload.
(Optional) Show a visible validation toast/inline error when the calculator refuses to advance past step 3 due to zero/empty monthly bill.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_intent: high-bill threshold uses >= 1_000_000 (10L) which gives score 45 + 20 (loan) + 15 (bill>=3L) = 80 -> HIGH intent. Matches spec. OK.

server.py POST /epc/projects also creates a lead with mobile='' - lead retrieval still works but lead's mobile is empty; if any downstream requires mobile this may break. Consider requiring or capturing customer mobile in EPC project payload.
server.py uses datetime.now() (naive local time) in gen_id while now_iso() uses timezone.utc — inconsistent but not user-facing.
EPCRegister.contactPerson field is required but not documented in the review spec — mismatch between spec and code (see minor backend issue).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads/EPC partners/projects via API and UI. Data persists in Mongo but is prefixed for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers leads, EPC register/projects, stats, and 404 paths. If EPCRegister model is relaxed to make contactPerson Optional, update test_register_epc_minimal to remove the fallback logic. All frontend data-testids referenced in the spec exist and are wired correctly.
